title: Every Settings tab opens without errors

steps.js: const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#settingsBody [data-tab], #settingsBody .tabs button, #settingsBody [role="tab"]')].filter(b => b.getClientRects().length); const seen = []; for (const t of tabs) { t.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); seen.push(t.textContent.trim() + ':' + document.querySelector('#settingsBody').innerText.length); } return seen
